arxiv-1711-02589.title: Gene flow across geographical barriers - scaling limits of random walks with obstacles
arxiv-1711-02589.creator: Raphaël Forien
arxiv-1711-02589.description: Abstract We study a class of random walks which behave like simple random walks outside of a bounded region around the origin and which are subject to a partial reflection near the origin. We obtain a non trivial scaling limit which behaves like reflected Brownian motion until its local time at zero reaches an exponential variable.

arxiv-2012-09651.title: Uniform Convolution and Fourier Restriction estimates for complex polynomial curves in ℂ 3 \mathbb{C}^{3}
arxiv-2012-09651.creator: Conor Meade
arxiv-2012-09651.description: Abstract We establish optimal ( p , q ) (p,q) ranges for two types of estimates associated to three dimensional complex polynomial curves. These are the estimates for the weighted restriction of the Fourier Transform to a complex polynomial curve, and the weighted Convolution Operator associated to a complex polynomial curve.

arxiv-2108-08300.title: Renormalized Wolfram model exhibiting non-relativistic quantum behavior
arxiv-2108-08300.creator: José Manuel Rodríguez Caballero
arxiv-2108-08300.description: Abstract We show a Wolfram model whose renormalization generates a sequence of approximations of a wave function having the Pauli-x matrix as Hamiltonian. 1 Introduction According to the principle of computational irreducibility, [ Wol02 ] , generically, computations that are not obviously simple cannot be made shorter.

arxiv-2212-04027.title: The molecular gas kinematics in the host galaxy of non-repeating FRB 180924B 2022 The molecular gas kinematics in the host galaxy of non-repeating FRB 180924B – References
arxiv-2212-04027.creator: Tzu-Yin Hsu, Tetsuya Hashimoto, Bunyo Hatsukade, Tomotsugu Goto, Po-Ya Wang, Chih Teng Ling, Simon C.-C. Ho, Yuri Uno
arxiv-2212-04027.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tzu-Yin Hsu, Tetsuya Hashimoto, Bunyo Hatsukade, Tomotsugu Goto, Po-Ya Wang, Chih Teng Ling, Simon C.-C. Ho, Yuri Uno. Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration transients with large dispersion measures. The origin of FRBs is still mysterious. One of the methods to comprehend FRB origin is to probe the physical environments of FRB host galaxies. Mapping molecular-gas kinematics in FRB host galaxies is critical because it results in star formation that is likely connected to the birth of FRB progenitors.

arxiv-2304-09172.title: Hyperbolic Image-Text Representations
arxiv-2304-09172.creator: Karan Desai, Maximilian Nickel, Tanmay Rajpurohit, Justin Johnson, Ramakrishna Vedantam
arxiv-2304-09172.description: Abstract Visual and linguistic concepts naturally organize themselves in a hierarchy, where a textual concept “dog” entails all images that contain dogs. Despite being intuitive, current large-scale vision and language models such as CLIP [ 70 ] do not explicitly capture such hierarchy. We propose MERU, a contrastive model that yields hyperbolic representations of images and text.

arxiv-2310-01470.title: Challenges in Modelling and Solving Plotting with PDDL Thanks: A paper extending this work and ( Espasa, Miguel, and Villaret 2022b ) has been submitted for journal publication.
arxiv-2310-01470.creator: Joan Espasa, Ian Miguel, Peter Nightingale, András Z. Salamon, Mateu Villaret
arxiv-2310-01470.description: Abstract We study a planning problem based on Plotting, a tile-matching puzzle video game published by Taito in 1989. The objective of this game is to remove a target number of coloured blocks from a grid by sequentially shooting blocks into the grid.

arxiv-2402-02356.title: Decentralized Sum-of-Nonconvex Optimization
arxiv-2402-02356.creator: Zhuanghua Liu, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low
arxiv-2402-02356.description: Abstract We consider the optimization problem of minimizing the sum-of-nonconvex function, i.e., a convex function that is the average of nonconvex components. The existing stochastic algorithms for such a problem only focus on a single machine and the centralized scenario. In this paper, we study the sum-of-nonconvex optimization in the decentralized setting.

arxiv-2410-06191.title: Benign Overfitting for Regression with Trained Two-Layer ReLU Networks
arxiv-2410-06191.creator: Junhyung Park, Patrick Blöbaum, Shiva Prasad Kasiviswanathan
arxiv-2410-06191.description: Abstract We study the least-square regression problem with a two-layer fully-connected neural network, with ReLU activation function, trained by gradient flow. Our first result is a generalization result, that requires no assumptions on the underlying regression function or the noise other than that they are bounded.

arxiv-2411-10045.title: Discovery of a Rare Group of Dwarf Galaxies in the Local Universe
arxiv-2411-10045.creator: Sanjaya Paudel, Cristiano G. Sabiu, Suk-Jin Yoon, Pierre-Alain Duc, Jaewon Yoo, Oliver Müller
arxiv-2411-10045.description: Abstract We report the discovery of a rare isolated group of five dwarf galaxies located at z = 0.0086 ( D D = 36 Mpc). All member galaxies are star-forming, blue, and gas-rich with g − r g-r indices ranging from 0.2 to 0.6 mag, and two of them show signs of ongoing mutual interaction.

arxiv-2506-19029.title: Dynamics of Phase-Separated Interfaces in Inhomogenous and Driven Mixtures
arxiv-2506-19029.creator: —Supplementary Information—
arxiv-2506-19029.description: Abstract Dynamics of Phase-Separated Interfaces in Inhomogenous and Driven Mixtures † Jacopo Romano a,‡ , Ramin Golestanian a,b and Benoît Mahault a We derive effective equations of motion governing the dynamics of sharp interfaces in phase-separated binary mixtures driven by spatio-temporal modulations of their material properties.

arxiv-2509-20228.title: Muse-it: A Tool for Analyzing Music Discourse on Reddit
arxiv-2509-20228.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . Music engagement encompasses a spectrum of interactions between individuals and music—ranging from the selection of music and the emotional responses it evokes to its influence on behavior, identity, and social connections. Social media platforms provide forums where users engage organically in online conversations on a variety of topics, offering a setting in which music behavior can be observed as it naturally occurs.

arxiv-2601-16042.title: Towards a Modern Theory of Chiralization
arxiv-2601-16042.creator: Nicola A. Spaldin
arxiv-2601-16042.description: Abstract The Modern Theory of Polarization, which rigorously defines the spontaneous electric polarization of a periodic solid and provides a recipe for its computation in electronic structure codes, transformed our understanding of ferroelectricity and related dielectric properties. Here we call for the development of an analogous Modern Theory of Chiralization.

europmc-pmc4810256.creator: Mihara T, Nishimura Y, Shimizu Y, Nishiyama H, Yoshikawa G, Uehara H, Hingamp P, Goto S, Ogata H.

pmc-10638447.title: Wavelet radiomics features from multiphase CT images for screening hepatocellular carcinoma: analysis and comparison
pmc-10638447.creator: Van Ha Tang, Soan T M Duong, Chanh D Tr Nguyen, Thanh M Huynh, Vo T Duc, Chien Phan, Huyen Le, Trung Bui, Steven Q H Truong
pmc-10638447.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Early detection of liver malignancy based on medical image analysis plays a crucial role in patient prognosis and personalized treatment. This task, however, is challenging due to several factors, including medical data scarcity and limited training samples. This paper presents a study of three important aspects of radiomics feature from multiphase computed tomography (CT) for classifying hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and other focal liver lesions: wavelet-transformed feature extraction, relevant feature selection, and radiomics features-based classification under the inadequate training samples.

pmc-10654140.title: Food safety culture maturity and its relation to company and employee characteristics
pmc-10654140.creator: Pauline Spagnoli, Peter Vlerick, Liesbeth Jacxsens
pmc-10654140.description: Three facets of food safety culture (FSC) (i.e., food safety management system (FSMS), human-organizational and human-individual building block), were diagnosed through a validated mixed-method assessment in twenty food processing companies. Many underdeveloped dimensions were detected in the FSMS and the human-organizational building block, while the human-individual building block was more mature. It was explored whether company (e.g.

pmc-10727255.title: Severe Fontan‐Associated Liver Disease and Its Association With Mortality
pmc-10727255.creator: Carlos‐Eduardo Guerrero‐Chalela, Judith Therrien, Yoni Grossman, Liming Guo, Aihua Liu, Ariane Marelli

We sought to: (1) estimate the probability of developing severe FALD in patients who undergo the Fontan procedure (Fontan patients), compared with severe liver complications in patients with a ventricular septal defect; (2) assess the severe FALD‐mortality association; and (3) identify risk factors for developing severe FALD.Methods and ResultsUsing the Quebec Congenital Heart Disease database, a total of 512 Fontan patients and 10 232 patients

pmc-11519406.title: The Preferential Use of Subcutaneous Arteries (SCIA-SB and SIEA) in Abdominal-based Autologous Breast Reconstruction with a Modified Flap Design
pmc-11519406.creator: Alberto Franchi, Luca Patanè, Carmen Elena Hummel, Jonas Walber, Shadi Najaf Zadeh, Abdul Rahman Jandali, Florian Jung
pmc-11519406.description: Background:Despite its many advantages, the deep inferior epigastric artery perforator flap requires fascial incision and intramuscular dissection, which can lead to pain and weakening of the abdominal wall. The superficial inferior epigastric artery (SIEA) flap offers an alternative to avoid this damage but is often considered unreliable due to its variable anatomy.

pmc-12737498.title: Mounting Evidence for an Expanded Host Range of Influenza B Viruses
pmc-12737498.creator: Marios Koutsakos, Rhys H. Parry, Michelle Wille
pmc-12737498.description: Influenza B viruses (IBV) belong to the family of Orthomyxoviridae and circulate annually in humans causing respiratory illness. Although they are considered an exclusively human pathogen, there is evidence of IBV infections in animals, including wildlife, companion animals and livestock.

pmc-12751137.title: Development and validation of the CHI-CAT score: a novel tool for assessing cancer-associated venous thromboembolism risk in China
pmc-12751137.creator: Xiaoli Qin, Xiurong Gao, Qin He, Min Xu, Yujie Yang, Qian Jiang
pmc-12751137.description: BackgroundIdentifying patients at risk for VTE and stratifying that risk is critical to determine who will benefit from thromboprophylaxis. China’s clinical practice still faces limitations, particularly regarding systematic and practical VTE risk assessment tools for cancer patients. This study aims to develop and validate the CHIna’s Cancer-Associated venous Thromboembolism risk assessment tool (CHI-CAT score) compared to the Khorana score.

pmc-12784892.title: Therapeutic Potential of CAR-CIK Cells in Acute Leukemia Relapsed Post Allogeneic Stem Cell Transplantation
pmc-12784892.creator: Martina Canichella, Paolo de Fabritiis, Elisabetta Abruzzese
pmc-12784892.description: Simple SummaryAdoptive cellular therapy has long been viewed as an attractive strategy to prevent and treat post-transplant relapse in acute leukemia. Donor lymphocyte infusions (DLIs) remain the conventional approach, offering clear graft-versus-leukemia (GVL) activity but at the cost of a significant risk of graft-versus-host disease (GvHD).

pmc-12958150.title: Towards Implementation of Equitable and Effective Non-Communicable Disease Policies
pmc-12958150.creator: Valerie A Luyckx, Randall Lou-Meda
pmc-12958150.description: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) have been the leading global causes of death and disease burden over the past two decades, but policies and actions to reduce these burdens have been insufficient. Many NCDs are preventable through the implementation of the World Health Organization (WHO) Best Buys – which initially focused on cardiovascular disease, cancer, respiratory disease, and diabetes.

pmc-12989354.title: The significance of component-resolved diagnostics in atopic dermatitis
pmc-12989354.creator: Małgorzata Błażowska, Julia Nowowiejska-Purpurowicz, Maria Tomasiak-Łozowska, Łukasz Błażowski, Iwona Flisiak
pmc-12989354.description: Atopic dermatitis (AD) is a common and chronic inflammatory skin disease characterized by an abnormal skin barrier, resulting in skin dryness, pruritus, and an increased risk of allergies and secondary infections. AD patients often show hypersensitivity to both food and airborne allergens.

pmc-13300358.title: Temporal dynamics of atrial fibrillation follow power-laws: evidence for self-organised criticality
pmc-13300358.creator: I Tonchev, P Kuklik, S Lorensini, C Strong, D Chapman, S S Shahrbabaki, K Tiver, M K Tung, N Stoyanov, A Ganesan
pmc-13300358.description: BackgroundAlternating organised and disorganised periods during atrial fibrillation (AF) are a phenomenon routinely observed in the electrophysiology lab, yet their mechanistic significance remains unclear. We hypothesised that the temporal distribution of organised and disorganised events differs between paroxysmal AF (PAF) and persistent AF (PsAF) and that power-law conformance of these distributions may serve as a marker of self-organised criticality (SOC).

pmc-13381528.description: Antibiotic shortages are increasing worldwide. Their impact on individual health and bacterial ecology is unknown, but it could be significant, and there is a lack of epidemiological evidence. pmc-13384637.title: Intelligent antigen design combined with yeast display enhances targeted immune responses
pmc-13384637.creator: Yun-Fei Ma, Guang-Hui Yin, Yu Pan, Ye Liu
pmc-13384637.description: Inducing strong and targeted humoral immune responses, a central goal of next-generation vaccine development, involves a complex series of interconnected steps. However, a comprehensive study that addresses and integrates all steps is still missing. Here, we present a study that addresses these steps to elicit precise neutralizing antibody (nAb) responses targeting focused epitope motifs.
